title: Quietly Quintessential Russian Saskatoon Berries Pilaf
description: A tangy and flaky Russian dish featuring Saskatoon berries, with a romantic twist, served in a bento box.
instructions: Heat the vegetable oil in a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute, stirring constantly to prevent burning.
Add the smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine.
Add the brown rice to the wok or skillet, stirring to combine with the onion and spice mixture.
Add the water to the wok or skillet, and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the water is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Stir in the Saskatoon berries and lemon juice.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the berries are heated through and the pilaf is fluffy.
Serve the pilaf in a bento box, garnished with additional Saskatoon berries if desired.
